rationale: The replication independently builds the paper's two-band RSLC Hamiltonian (Eq. 3) and computes Boltzmann conductivities, confirming the headline claim: |SP|=1 with opposite full spin polarization on orthogonal axes in the ridge limit, degrading smoothly at finite δ. The coverage-flip extension adds a four-band spin+layer model that explicitly verifies the 'L' in RSLC: opposite layer polarization P(R1)=+1, P(R2)=-1, {C2||S4z} symmetry (residual=0), layer-locked currents, and Ez-switchable degeneracy. DFT material validation and relativistic anomalous Hall (SOC) are deliberately scoped out, preventing full coverage, but all tight-binding mechanism claims match exactly.
